conventions.commits: Conventional commits with feat/fix/chore prefixes; DCO signed; issue references in PR titles
conventions.testing: Unit tests in language module files (mod tests block); integration tests in crates/aptu-coder-core/tests/integration_tests.rs; test patterns verify query compilation, element extraction, and inheritance extraction
conventions.linting: clippy with deny-level lints: undocumented_unsafe_blocks, unwrap_used, expect_used (test exemptions via cfg_attr); cargo fmt --check; cargo deny check advisories licenses
conventions.error_handling: thiserror for error types; Option<T> for fallible operations; bounds checks on source byte ranges; no panics in production code

patterns: Language module file (e.g., java.rs) exports ELEMENT_QUERY, CALL_QUERY, REFERENCE_QUERY, IMPORT_QUERY, DEFUSE_QUERY as const &str
Language module implements extract_function_name, find_receiver_type, find_method_for_receiver, extract_inheritance as optional handlers
get_language_info() in mod.rs matches on language name string and returns LanguageInfo struct with queries and handlers
get_ts_language() in mod.rs matches on language name and returns tree_sitter::Language object
EXTENSION_MAP in lang.rs maps file extensions to language identifiers; language_for_extension() performs case-insensitive lookup
supported_languages() in lang.rs returns static slice of all language names for discovery
Integration tests create temp files with language-specific code, call analyze_file(), verify semantic.functions and semantic.classes extraction

constraints: All languages unconditionally compiled in; no lang-* feature gates
tree-sitter version pinned to 0.27.1 in workspace dependencies
tree-sitter-php must be added to workspace.dependencies and crates/aptu-coder-core/Cargo.toml
Language must be registered in EXTENSION_MAP (lang.rs), get_language_info() (mod.rs), and get_ts_language() (mod.rs)
DEFUSE_QUERY is required for semantic analysis (def-use extraction); cannot be None for PHP
Query strings must compile against tree-sitter-php grammar; node kinds and field names must match grammar exactly
extract_inheritance handler required for OOP language to support class hierarchy analysis
All unsafe code requires SAFETY comment (clippy::undocumented_unsafe_blocks = deny)
No unwrap() or expect() in production code (test exemptions via cfg_attr)
test_coverage: Integration tests verify language parsing (no parse errors), function/class extraction, and inheritance extraction. Unit tests in language modules verify query compilation and handler correctness. Extension mapping tests verify case-insensitive lookup and coverage of EXTENSION_MAP. Acceptance tests verify end-to-end analyze_file() output format.

library_findings.relevant_api: function_definition, method_declaration, class_declaration, interface_declaration, trait_declaration, enum_declaration node types; base_clause (extends), class_interface_clause (implements) for inheritance; name field for identifiers
library_findings.notes: Grammar uses base_clause and class_interface_clause instead of parent_class/interfaces fields; method_declaration has name field; function_definition is top-level function; trait_declaration and interface_declaration are distinct node types

library_findings.relevant_api: Query::new(), QueryCursor, Node::child_by_field_name(), Node::named_child(), Node::kind(), Node::start_byte(), Node::end_byte()
library_findings.notes: Query strings use S-expression syntax with @capture annotations; field names must match grammar exactly; byte offsets used for source text extraction

approaches.name: Approach A: Minimal PHP support (functions, classes, interfaces only)
approaches.description: Add php.rs with ELEMENT_QUERY matching function_definition, method_declaration, class_declaration, interface_declaration; CALL_QUERY for function calls; DEFUSE_QUERY for local variables and assignments; no inheritance extraction. Register in mod.rs and lang.rs. Add .php extension to EXTENSION_MAP.
cons: May require follow-up work for full language coverage

approaches.name: Approach B: Full PHP support with inheritance extraction (recommended)
approaches.description: Add php.rs with ELEMENT_QUERY covering function_definition, method_declaration, class_declaration, interface_declaration, trait_declaration, enum_declaration; CALL_QUERY for calls; DEFUSE_QUERY for def-use sites; implement extract_inheritance handler walking base_clause and class_interface_clause. Register in mod.rs and lang.rs. Add .php extension to EXTENSION_MAP. Add integration test verifying class/interface/trait/enum extraction and inheritance.
pros: Consistent with Java, C#, Swift patterns

approaches.name: Approach C: Phased rollout with optional handlers
approaches.description: Phase 1: Add php.rs with basic queries (no handlers). Phase 2: Add extract_inheritance after initial review. Register in mod.rs with all handlers as None initially, then add them in follow-up PR. Allows incremental review and testing.
cons: Requires two PRs and two reviews

recommendation: Approach B (Full PHP support with inheritance extraction). The issue title 'add PHP language support' implies complete support, not partial. The codebase pattern (Java, C#, Swift, Kotlin) consistently includes extract_inheritance for OOP languages. PHP's trait and enum support are first-class language features (not legacy), so omitting them would be incomplete. The implementation complexity is medium but well-established by prior integrations. A single comprehensive PR is preferable to phased rollout for language support.
language_info_struct_citation:
pub struct LanguageInfo {
    pub name: &'static str,
    pub language: Language,
    pub element_query: &'static str,
    pub call_query: &'static str,
    pub reference_query: Option<&'static str>,
    pub import_query: Option<&'static str>,
    pub impl_query: Option<&'static str>,
    pub impl_trait_query: Option<&'static str>,
    pub defuse_query: Option<&'static str>,
    pub extract_function_name: Option<ExtractFunctionNameHandler>,
    pub find_method_for_receiver: Option<FindMethodForReceiverHandler>,
    pub find_receiver_type: Option<FindReceiverTypeHandler>,
    pub extract_inheritance: Option<ExtractInheritanceHandler>,
}
element_query_draft:
r"
(function_definition
  name: (name) @function_name) @function
(method_declaration
  name: (name) @method_name) @function
(class_declaration
  name: (name) @class_name) @class
(interface_declaration
  name: (name) @interface_name) @class
(trait_declaration
  name: (name) @trait_name) @class
(enum_declaration
  name: (name) @enum_name) @class
"
inheritance_walk_citation: From tree-sitter-php grammar (common/define-grammar.js): class_declaration has optional base_clause child (extends keyword followed by comma-separated names) and optional class_interface_clause child (implements keyword followed by comma-separated names). Walk class_declaration node's children; for each base_clause child, extract its named_child(0) as the superclass name; for each class_interface_clause child, iterate named_child() to extract each interface name. Field names are not used; node kinds are base_clause and class_interface_clause.
